=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The bash case pattern `changelog.d/*.md|agents.d/*.md` is unanchored, so it also matches strings like `xchangelog.d/foo.md` or `scripts/.../agents.d/foo.md`; the downstream `case "${_ff_path#*/}" in */*)` filter still excludes nested paths, but a path like `changelog.d.foo.md` (no slash) would slip through the first case and have its stage-2 blob compared/staged.
  WHY: In practice `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` only emits repo-root-relative paths, so the corner cases are theoretical — but the first case should anchor at the start to keep the intent obvious and avoid any future path-collision regression.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The error annotation is now shared between the manifest-only path and the folded-fragment path, but the literal text still says `Manifest union-merge: unhandled reason=integration_sync … refusing to commit the manifest-only resolution of ${MANIFEST_UNION_PATH}`. The new code prints `refusing to commit the deterministic resolution (manifest or folded fragments)` and drops the `${MANIFEST_UNION_PATH}` interpolation; if the deferred commit is a fragment-only deferred (`_ff_defer_commit=true` only), the reason label is still "Manifest union-merge", which misleads operator triage.
  WHY: When a folded-fragment deferred commit fails, the GitHub Actions log will show `::error::Manifest union-merge: … folded fragments` instead of a fragment-specific error, so an operator triaging via the error text may look for a manifest issue that does not exist.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
